posting.fund.funds_off.en: Funds are turned off, so a journal line can't carry a fund. Remove the fund from the line, or turn funds on in Accounting settings.

posting.fund.unknown.en: Fund {fund} doesn't exist. Choose one of the company's funds.

posting.fund.archived.en: The fund {fund} is archived and takes no new postings. Unarchive it first, or choose another fund.

posting.fund.unbalanced.en: The lines of {fund} don't balance: they are off by {difference} {currency}. Each fund's debits must equal its credits.

posting.fund.restricted_net_assets_needs.en: A line on account {code}, restricted net assets, must carry a restricted fund.

posting.fund.retained_earnings_restricte.en: A line on account {code}, retained earnings, can't carry the restricted fund {fund}. Restricted money is recorded on restricted net assets.

fund.not_enabled.en: Funds are turned off. Turn them on in Accounting settings before adding a fund.

fund.not_found.en: Celerp couldn't find this fund. It may belong to another company.

fund.name_taken.en: There is already a fund named {name}. Choose another name.

fund.purpose_required.en: A restricted fund needs a purpose: what the money may be spent on.

fund.restriction_locked.en: {fund} already has postings, so whether it is restricted and its purpose can't change. Create a new fund and move the money to it instead.

fund.balance_held.en: These funds still hold balances: {funds}. Bring each to zero first.

posting.fund.stock_unrestricted.en: A line on account {code}, which holds stock or its cost, can't carry the restricted fund {fund}. Stock and its cost are held unrestricted.

posting.fund.movement_outside.en: This entry moves money of {fund} between funds. Restricted money moves only through Transfer between funds, Release from restriction or Reallocate restricted funds.

posting.fund.movement_needs_user.en: Money of {fund} moves between funds only when a person posts the movement, never by an automatic posting.

posting.fund.movement_permission.en: Moving money of {fund} between funds needs the {permission} permission.

posting.fund.movement_template.en: This movement of {fund} doesn't fit its type. A transfer moves money between unrestricted funds, a release takes restricted money to an unrestricted fund, a reallocation moves it to a restricted fund with the same purpose, and an opening assigns unrestricted balances to funds. Each one only moves balance-sheet accounts between funds.

posting.fund.movement_income_expense.en: Account {code} is an income or expense account. A movement between funds moves balance-sheet accounts only.

posting.fund.movement_exceeds_balance.en: {fund} holds {available} {currency} on account {code}, so it can't give {amount} {currency}.

posting.fund.reallocation_needs_authoriz.en: Reallocating money of {fund} needs a reason and a reference to the donor's written authorization.

posting.fund.opening_restricted_negative.en: This opening would leave the net assets of {fund} below zero. Assign the assets that cover its liabilities in the same opening.

posting.fund.release_backing_missing.en: A release from {fund} must name the purpose spending it pays for: posted expense lines, charged to no fund, that add up to the amount released.

posting.fund.release_backing_charged.en: That spending is already charged to a fund, so it can't back a release from {fund}. Only spending charged to no fund can.

posting.fund.release_backing_used.en: The spending on account {code} has already been released from restriction, so it can't back this release from {fund} as well.

posting.fund.movement_void.en: This entry moves money of {fund} between funds, so it can't be voided. Reverse it instead.

fund.movement_same_fund.en: Choose two different funds. Money can't move from a fund to itself.

fund.movement_not_found.en: Celerp couldn't find this movement between funds, or it isn't posted.

fund.transfer_allocation_total.en: The amounts by fund add up to {allocated} {currency}, but the transfer moves {amount} {currency}. Change them so they add up to the amount transferred.

accounting.close_not_found.en: No close of the fiscal year ending {year_end} is posted, so there is nothing to reverse.

posting.fund.origin_fixed.en: This line came from {source}; its origin cannot be changed

posting.fund.document_origin_fixed.en: This document came from {source}; its origin cannot be changed

posting.fund.key_not_taken.en: A line carries a field these books do not take: {field}

posting.fund.choice_not_granted.en: Choose the fund for line {line} with its Fund control

posting.fund.document_choice_not_granted.en: Choose the fund for this document with its Fund for this document control

posting.fund.choice_missing.en: Choose a fund or Unrestricted for line {line}

posting.fund.document_choice_missing.en: Choose a fund or Unrestricted for this document

posting.fund.choice_line_unknown.en: This document no longer has that line, so its fund choice was not saved.

posting.fund.choice_local_line.en: Line {line} didn't come from outside, so it has no fund to choose. Set its fund on the line itself.

posting.fund.document_posted.en: This document has posted; use Change fund

posting.fund.inbound_key.en: This record came in with {field}, which these books set themselves now that they use funds. Remove {field} and send it again.

fund.turn_on_outside_keys.en: {count} records carry fund fields sent from outside: {records}. Post them (they post as today while funds are off) or delete them, then turn funds on.

fund.turn_off_choices_held.en: Clear or post the fund choices on {records} first

fund.choices_cleared_lines.en: Amounts changed, so the fund choices on lines {lines} were cleared: choose again

fund.choices_cleared_both.en: Amounts changed, so the fund choices on lines {lines} and the fund for this document were cleared: choose again

fund.choices_cleared_document.en: Amounts changed, so the fund for this document was cleared: choose again

notice.peer_journal_needs_funds.title.en: Journal entry from your accountant waiting for funds

notice.peer_journal_needs_funds.body.en: {memo}, dated {date}, from {firm} has not posted yet: choose a fund for each line in From your accountant, then post it. {firm} has been told it is waiting.

posting.fund.hold_changed.en: Your accountant changed this entry. Review it again, then post it.

fund.payment_allocation_total.en: The amounts by fund add up to {allocated} {currency}, but the payment is {amount} {currency}. Change them so they add up to the payment.

posting.fund.allocation_exceeds_open.en: {fund} has {open} {currency} open on this document, so the payment can't settle {amount} {currency} of it.

posting.fund.choice_needed.en: {record} came from {source}: choose the fund for this document.

posting.fund.note_exceeds_open.en: {fund} has {open} {currency} open on this document, so the credit note can apply at most {applicable} {currency} here.

fund.choices_cleared_by_source.total.en: The total was changed by {source}: choose the fund again

fund.choices_cleared_by_source.lines.en: The lines were changed by {source}: choose the fund again

fund.choices_cleared_by_source.tax.en: The tax was changed by {source}: choose the fund again

posting.fund.inbound_line_key.en: Line {line} came in with {field}, which these books set themselves now that they use funds. Remove {field} and send it again.

posting.fund.file_key.en: The file gives {field}. Choose funds on the import screen, not in the file.

fund.connection_unknown.en: These books have no connection by that name. Open the connection from Settings > Connectors and set its default fund there.

fund.default_stale.en: Someone changed this default fund after you opened it. Try again to see the current one.

posting.fund.choice_empty.en: Choose a fund for this document, for every line from outside, or for at least one line.

posting.fund.import_funds_off.en: Funds are turned off, so this import can't choose them. Turn funds on in Accounting settings, or import without fund choices.

posting.fund.choice_record_unknown.en: {record} isn't in this import. Choose funds only for the records it brings.

posting.fund.import_line_unknown.en: {record} has no line {line}. Choose funds only for lines the file has, by their number.

posting.fund.line_without_choice.en: Line {line} has no fund of its own.

docs_import.fund_title.en: Fund for each document and line

docs_import.fund_hint.en: Choose the fund these documents belong to, or Unrestricted. A line left at -- takes the fund chosen for its document.

recon.fund_hint.en: Left at Unrestricted, money moved off an asset or a liability (a clearing account, a receivable, tax payable) is shared among the funds that hold it. Pick a fund to take it all from that fund.

fund.waiting.count.en: {count} outside documents waiting for a fund choice

fund.waiting.count_one.en: 1 outside document waiting for a fund choice

sync_accounts.funds_hint.en: Choose a fund or Unrestricted for each line, then Post. Set all outside lines to fills every line still at --.

fund.defaults_hint.en: Documents and entries from these connections take the default fund when they first arrive and post without waiting for a choice. You can still change a document's fund until it posts.

fund.default_inactive.en: Inactive: {user} can no longer choose funds

fund.default_read_only.en: Only users who can manage funds can change this

fund.default_cleared.en: Default fund for {source} cleared. New documents from it will wait for a fund choice.

posting.fund.change_reason_missing.en: Say why the fund is changing. The reason is kept with the change.

posting.fund.change_not_outside.en: Change fund is only for records that came from outside. Use the document void or the journal reverse.

posting.fund.change_not_posted.en: This record has not posted yet. Choose its fund before it posts.

posting.fund.change_settled.en: A payment or note is recorded against this document. Void it, change the fund, then record it again.

posting.fund.change_opening_held.en: The opening balances hold {document}: reverse its opening balance and enter it again with the fund.

posting.fund.change_backing.en: Release {release} is backed by this entry: reverse the release first.

posting.fund.change_needs_reallocation.en: Moving money of {fund} to {to} needs the Reallocate restricted funds permission and the same purpose on both funds.

posting.fund.change_exceeds_balance.en: {fund} holds {available} {currency}; this change would take {amount} {currency} out of it.

posting.fund.change_stale.en: Someone changed this record after you opened it. Try again to see it as it is now.

funds.help.en: Track money by fund. A restricted fund holds gifts a donor limited to a purpose; an unrestricted fund holds money set aside for a use of your own. Lines with no fund post as unrestricted.

funds.off_help.en: Funds are off. Turn them on to give lines on invoices, bills, bank lines and journal entries a fund.

funds.on_help.en: Funds are on. You can turn them off again once every fund is back to zero.

funds.turned_on.en: Funds are on. Add your first fund below.

funds.empty.en: No funds yet. Everything posts as unrestricted until you add one.

funds.restricted_check.en: Restricted: a donor limited what this money may be spent on

funds.purpose_hint.en: What the money may be spent on

funds.archived.en: {name} archived. It takes no new postings until you unarchive it.

funds.move_help.en: Each movement posts its own journal entry with the reason you give. To undo one, reverse it in Fund activity.

funds.transfer_help.en: Move money between two unrestricted funds, or between a fund and money with no fund.

funds.release_help.en: Move restricted money to an unrestricted fund once it has been spent on its purpose. The release names the spending it pays for.

funds.reallocate_help.en: Move restricted money to another restricted fund with the same purpose, when the donor has agreed in writing.

funds.opening_help.en: Give part of an account's balance to a fund when you start using funds. Each line takes the amount from money with no fund.

funds.release_spending_help.en: Tick the spending this release pays for. The release is the total of the amounts ticked.

funds.release_spending_empty.en: No spending is waiting for a release. Post the purpose spending with no fund first, then release it here.

rpt.fund_balance_sheet_desc.en: Each asset and liability account by fund, with each fund's net assets and how much is restricted

rpt.fund_activity_desc.en: What each fund received, spent, released and transferred over a period, with the movements between funds

rpt.fund_reconciliation_desc.en: Checks that the funds add up to the company ledger and lists anything that needs a look

fund_reports.no_movements.en: No movements between funds in this period.

fund_reports.balanced.en: Every account's funds add up to the company ledger.

fund_reports.differences.en: Accounts where the funds and the company ledger differ

fund_reports.mirrors.en: Entries that mirror each other across funds

fund_reports.attribution.en: Entries on another fund than their document's lines

settings_accounting.reverse_close_help.en: Undo the latest close of a year, for example to post a late bill. Unlock the period first, then close the year again when you are done.

documents.fund_split_rule.en: A payment settles each fund in proportion to what it has open.

documents.allocate_by_fund_hint.en: Leave these empty to keep that split. If you fill them in, they must add up to the payment.

recognition.err_service_period.en: {line} recognizes over its service period, so it needs a service start and end, with the end on or after the start.

recognition.err_flag_invalid.en: Recognize over the service period must be on or off. Send true or false.

recognition.err_month.en: {month} is not a month. Send it as YYYY-MM, for example 2026-01.

recognition.err_month_locked.en: The books are locked through {lock_date}, so this run cannot be dated in its own month. Date it {first_open}, the first open day, or move the period lock.

recognition.err_post_on.en: This run can only be dated {first_open}: a run is dated the last day of its month, or the first open day when its month is locked.

recognition.err_run_not_posted.en: No recognition run of {month} is posted, so there is nothing to reverse.

recognition.notice_lapsed.body.en: Automatic recognition stopped: authorization lapsed. The member who turned it on no longer manages accounting or has left. Post the runs on Revenue recognition, or turn automatic posting on again.

recognition.err_amend_posted.en: A posted run covers a day from {effective} on. Reverse those runs first, then amend the schedule.

recognition.err_amend_invalid.en: The service end can't be before the amendment takes effect, and the new amount can't be less than the {held} the schedule plans before that day.

recognition.intro.en: Revenue an invoice defers is recognized month by month over its service period. Each ended month's runs wait here until they are posted, by hand or automatically.

recognition.empty.en: No revenue is deferred. Set an item or agreement to recognize over its service period to start.

recognition.auto_hint.en: When it is on, each month's runs post on their own once the month ends, while that month is open. Earlier months and locked months wait for you to post them here.

recognition.turned_off.en: Automatic posting turned off. Runs now wait for you to post them.

recognition.reversed_month.en: Runs of {month} reversed. They are outstanding again.

recognition.agrees.en: Agrees with the deferred revenue accounts.

recognition.differs.en: Differs from the deferred revenue accounts by {amount}.

recognition.void_hint.en: The documents these schedules came from were voided. Reverse their posted runs to take the revenue they recognized back to deferred revenue.

subscriptions.err_beneficiary.en: Choose the member this membership is for, or leave it empty.

subscriptions.err_grace_days.en: Enter the grace period as a whole number of days, from 0 to 365.

subscriptions.members_empty.en: No members yet. Add a membership tier, then New membership.

subscriptions.members_intro.en: Each member's standing comes from their latest bill: current until it falls due, in grace for the agreement's grace days after that, then lapsed. A paid or fully credited bill reads current again.

donors.statement_wording_default.en: Thank you, {name}, for your support. This statement lists the gifts we received from you in this period.

donors.err_confirm_send.en: Confirm the send first: statements go out by email and cannot be recalled once delivered.

donors.intro.en: Each donor's gifts received and kept in the period, net of refunds. Send each donor a statement of their gifts by email.

donors.wording_hint.en: Write {name} where the donor's name should go.

donors.send_hint.en: Each donor with an email address gets one email for this period. Donors who already have this statement with this wording are not sent it again. A sent email cannot be recalled.

donors.confirm_send.en: I have checked the list above. Send the statements.

donors.done_sent.en: {sent} sent, {skipped} skipped with no email address.

donors.done_already.en: {already} already sent earlier, not sent again.

donors.done_failed.en: Could not send to {names}. Select Send statements to try again.

subscriptions.err_trial_first_bill.en: The first bill date is the trial end, {day}. Change the trial end to move it.

subscriptions.plans_empty.en: No plans yet. A plan is a service item in the SaaS plan category.

subscriptions.plans_hint.en: Each plan with its price and how many active or paused subscribers it has. Open a plan to change its name or price.

subscriptions.new_subscriber_hint.en: The plan is billed at its price on your default price list, once per seat. With a trial end, the first bill date is the trial end.

subscriptions.err_seats.en: Seats must be a whole number of at least 1, not {seats}.

subscriptions.err_not_plan.en: {name} is not a SaaS plan. Choose an item in the SaaS plan category.

subscriptions.err_amend_before_billed.en: A change can take effect from {day} at the earliest, the start of the latest billed period. Choose {day} or a later date.

subscriptions.err_amend_line.en: This subscription has no such line. Reload the page and try again.

subscriptions.err_amend_unchanged.en: These are already the quantities on that date, so nothing would change.

subscriptions.err_amend_draft.en: This subscription is still a draft. Change its lines on its page instead.

subscriptions.quantities_hint.en: Change a quantity, such as the number of seats, from a date. Periods from that date bill the new quantity. If the date falls in a period already billed, a credit note and a new document settle the days left. To undo a change, change the quantity back from the same date.

subscriptions.done_amended_settled.en: Quantities changed from {day}. {credit_note} credits the days already billed and {document} bills them at the new quantities.

subscriptions.revenue_hint.en: Recurring revenue, churn and cohorts of your sales subscriptions, measured at the end of each month. Change the range or pick a currency to see a different view.

subscriptions.revenue_empty.en: No recurring revenue yet. Add a subscriber or plan to see MRR.

subscriptions.cohorts_hint.en: Subscriptions grouped by the month they started, with the share still active and their MRR at each month end since.

subscriptions.metrics_not_converted.en: Not counted in {month} because they have no exchange rate: {count}. Add the rate on each subscription in another currency to include it.

subscriptions.def_mrr.en: Monthly recurring revenue (MRR): for each active subscription, the subtotal of its lines on the last day of the month, less its discount, scaled to one month. Quarterly is divided by 3 and yearly by 12. A period counted in days is converted at 365 / 12 days a month. Tax, shipping and one-off invoices are not included.

subscriptions.def_active.en: Active: subscriptions that are active on the last day of the month, have started by then and have not reached their term end. Paused and cancelled subscriptions are not active.

subscriptions.def_movement.en: New, expansion, contraction and churned: how MRR changed since the previous month end, from subscriptions that started, grew, shrank or stopped.

subscriptions.def_logo_churn.en: Logo churn: subscriptions that stopped, as a share of those active at the previous month end.

subscriptions.def_revenue_churn.en: Revenue churn: churned and contraction MRR together, as a share of MRR at the previous month end.

subscriptions.def_currency.en: Subscriptions in another currency are converted at their own exchange rate. Pick a currency to see only the subscriptions in it, without conversion.

subscriptions.err_metrics_order.en: The From date is after the To date. Choose a From date on or before the To date.

subscriptions.err_metrics_range.en: The range is longer than 10 years. Choose a To date within 10 years of the From date.

subscriptions.err_metrics_currency.en: That currency code isn't recognized. Use a three-letter code such as USD.

subscriptions.err_collection_off.en: Automatic collection is not available. Connect Stripe through Celerp Cloud to turn it on.

subscriptions.err_no_card_on_file.en: The payer has no card on file. Send them a setup link first.

subscriptions.err_payer_not_contact.en: The payer is not one of your contacts. Choose a contact as the payer first.

subscriptions.err_payer_no_email.en: The payer has no email address. Add one to the contact first.

subscriptions.err_cloud_unreachable.en: Could not reach Celerp Cloud. Try again.

subscriptions.err_setup_link_daily_limit.en: Too many setup links for this payer today. Try again tomorrow.

subscriptions.err_setup_email_daily_limi.en: Too many setup emails for this payer today. Copy the link instead, or try again tomorrow.

subscriptions.err_no_active_binding.en: The payer has no card on file to remove.

collection.access_removed_title.en: Automatic collection stopped: Stripe access was removed

collection.access_removed_body.en: Cards on file can no longer be charged. Invoices still bill and wait to be paid. Reconnect Stripe, then send each payer a new setup link.

notice.payment_dispute.body.en: A customer disputed the {amount} card payment on {document} with their bank. {status}

documents.dispute_created.en: The customer disputed this payment with their bank.

documents.dispute_funds_withdrawn.en: Stripe took the disputed amount from your balance. It is held in Disputed payments until the dispute is decided.

documents.dispute_funds_reinstated.en: Stripe returned the disputed amount to your balance.

documents.dispute_won.en: The dispute was decided in your favour.

documents.dispute_lost.en: The dispute was decided for the customer. The amount moved to Payment dispute losses.

documents.dispute_closed.en: The dispute was closed without taking any money.

notice.payment_dispute_not_recorded.titl.en: Card payment dispute not recorded on {document}

notice.payment_dispute_not_recorded.body.en: Celerp Cloud reported dispute {dispute} of {amount} on {document}, but it could not be recorded: {reason} Record any money taken in a journal entry.

notice.payment_dispute_not_recorded.docu.en: the invoice is no longer here.

notice.payment_dispute_not_recorded.unma.en: the payment is still among the unmatched payments.

notice.payment_dispute_not_recorded.paym.en: the payment is no longer on the invoice.

notice.payment_dispute_not_recorded.curr.en: it is in another currency than the payment.

notice.payment_dispute_not_recorded.amou.en: it is for more than the payment.

subscriptions.card_needs_action.en: The card on file needs the payer to confirm it. Send them a new setup link.

subscriptions.card_access_removed.en: No card on file: Stripe access was removed. Reconnect Stripe, then send the payer a new setup link.

subscriptions.receipt_not_sent.en: The payer's receipt for this card was not emailed. It has the link to remove the card.

subscriptions.remove_card_confirm.en: Remove the payer's card on file? Nothing more is charged to it until the payer puts a card on file again.

subscriptions.setup_link_copy.en: Send this link to the payer. They open it to put a card on file. It expires in 7 days.

subscriptions.done_setup_link_emailed.en: Setup link emailed to the payer.

subscriptions.setup_link_not_emailed.en: Email not sent. Copy the link or try again.

subscriptions.done_receipt_sent.en: Receipt emailed to the payer again.

subscriptions.done_card_removed.en: Card removed. Nothing more is charged to it.

collection.status_requires_action.en: Waiting for the payer to confirm the charge.

collection.status_unverifiable.en: Celerp Cloud could not confirm the charge

collection.stopped_mode_manual.en: the agreement no longer collects automatically

collection.stopped_no_card_on_file.en: the payer has no card on file

collection.stopped_authorizer_lapsed.en: the person who turned it on can no longer authorize it

collection.stopped_collection_off.en: Celerp Cloud no longer offers it

collection.stopped_no_books.en: the company's time zone or the invoice's exchange rate cannot be used

collection.stopped_amount_changed.en: the invoice now owes less than the charge asked for

subscriptions.err_collection_sales_only.en: Only a sales agreement can collect from a card. A purchasing agreement records what you owe a supplier.

posting.fund.change_moves_nothing.en: Nothing would move: each line already has its own fund. Change the fund on the lines instead.

fund.change_hint.en: This document has posted. Saving voids its entries and posts them again on the new fund.

fixed_assets.err_line_other_fund.en: This line is on {line_fund} and {number} is on {asset_fund}. An asset keeps the fund it was bought on, so use a line on {asset_fund}.

fixed_assets.err_change_fund_splits_asse.en: {number} was bought on lines that would end up on different funds ({funds}). An asset keeps one fund, so choose the same fund for all of its lines.

fixed_assets.err_change_fund_class_move.en: {number} moved with the account change of {cls} on {date}. Undo that account change, change the fund, then make the account change again.
